title: Engineering Manager
description:
**About Fervo Energy**
----------------------

Fervo Energy (NASDAQ: FRVO) is a modern power company developing next-generation geothermal resources to meet the growing demand for affordable, reliable, 24/7 carbon-free energy. Our mission is to transform geothermal into America's most dependable and affordable source of clean, around-the-clock power. By combining innovations in horizontal drilling, fiber-optic sensing, and advanced reservoir engineering, Fervo has developed a repeatable approach to building utility-scale enhanced geothermal systems. Our flagship Cape Station development in Utah is planned to deliver 500 MW of firm, carbon-free power, and we are advancing a development pipeline of more than 50 GW. Join us and work alongside world-class engineers, geoscientists, operators, project builders, and business leaders working to make geothermal a cornerstone of a more reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy future.

**Position Description**
------------------------

The Engineering Manager owns the ORC equipment and plant layout: everything in the power cycle except the turbine and generator. That means the air-cooled condenser, heat exchangers, pumps, piping, cabling layout, and associated low-voltage equipment. You own design, cost, and schedule for that scope from preliminary design through startup, on every project in every basin Fervo builds in. You lead a cross-functional team of process, mechanical, electrical, and structural/civil engineers and are accountable for schedule, budget, cost forecasting, quality of work, and the performance of the OEMs and suppliers who build the equipment. You will work every day with the electrical, controls, turbine and pipeline teams, as well as with Supply Chain, Construction, and Operations. We are looking for an engineer who knows thermodynamics, heat transfer, and fluid systems cold, has led and grown a team of engineers before, and has shipped real hardware in a manufacturing or hardware business. description:

This is not a report-maintenance role: the Manager anticipates problems, challenges information, coordinates across disciplines and helps the team make informed decisions quickly.

* Measure and validate physical progress and reconcile it with cost and schedule performance.
* Anticipate risks and issues, challenge contractor and internal information, and drive timely resolution.
* Present project status, risks, challenges and required decisions clearly to senior management.
* Coordinate with Construction, Engineering, Contracts, Procurement, Finance and contractor teams.
* Work directly in the detail: resolve issues, deliver results and lead by example.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE**

* Strong background in large-scale, complex construction projects (data centers, power generation or other major capital projects preferred); understanding of field execution and construction priorities.
